title: GAIN: A Benchmark for Goal-Aligned Decision-Making of Large Language Models under Imperfect Norms
reasoning: The GAIN benchmark explicitly includes 'Emotional/Ethical Appeal' as one of five key contextual pressures used to evaluate LLM decision-making. It incorporates ethical dilemmas and values like fairness, loyalty, and empathy into its test scenarios to see how they influence norm deviation versus goal alignment.
